question:

solution:
According to the given dice:

 
• Alternate surface are opposite to each other.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d3ed765fb1c7f471105a68874d6d6a474486edc3e794d99d39cbae8062a0243b.png]
